how_to_update: Hand-kept. Each Tuesday, before the build, add the coming week's quarterback news that the nflverse rosters and injury reports cannot show yet: trades, signings, benchings and starters named by the team or reported by a named reporter. One entry per team under the week number: 'starter' (the name as nflverse spells it), 'conf' ('named' = the team or a reporter says he is the starter; 'expected' = the coach or a reporter says he is expected or could start), 'sources' (who, what, when in UTC), and 'unavailable' (quarterbacks in the team's season figures who will not play for it, with why). Never add a starter without a source. The injury report still decides game statuses; this file only covers what it cannot.

sources.what: Mendoza will take over as the starting quarterback after the Cousins trade

sources.who: Adam Schefter and Ian Rapoport on X
sources.what: Raiders trade Cousins to the Vikings for a 2027 third-round pick
Cousins could start Sunday's game at Green Bay; not yet confirmed by the team
Cardinals placed Gardner Minshew on injured reserve; not expected to play again this season

unavailable.why: on injured reserve (torn UCL), reported 10 Nov

sources.what: Kyle McCord becomes Miami's starting quarterback; Malik Willis placed on injured reserve (groin)
Coach Jesse Minter said he expects Brissett, acquired from Arizona, to start Monday night against the Chargers
Drake Maye has a serious lower-leg injury from the Lions game and is expected to be out indefinitely; DeVito expected to start (https://www.bostonglobe.com/2026/11/16/sports/drake-maye-injury)

unavailable.why: lower-leg injury on 15 Nov, out indefinitely

sources.what: Seahawks expect Darnold (quad, ribs) to start week 12 after the bye; 'If he gets through the week well, he'll start'
Mason Rudolph listed QB1, Will Howard QB2, Drew Allar QB3
Rodgers did not practise: 'Not injury related - personal matter'

unavailable.why: released (CUT on the week 12 weekly roster)

notes.11: Checked 19 Nov: no trade, signing or named starter the rosters cannot show. Week 10's new starters (Beck ARI, McCord MIA, Mendoza LV, Cousins MIN, Brissett BAL) are now in the play-by-play. Mayfield (TB, foot) and Geno Smith (NYJ, ankle) were reported likely to play; the injury report decides.
